descriptor.name: SanGIS unstacked parcel reference polygons
descriptor.scope: SanGIS unstacked San Diego County Assessor tax parcel reference polygons. Encinitas review uses the unchanged frozen city locator and a bounded 0.001-degree 13-cell grid. PARCELID is the native polygon key; selected APNs are not stable identity. No municipality-wide completeness, title, survey accuracy or reuse authorization is claimed.

evidence: First-party county layer metadata identifies SanGIS Assessor tax parcel reference polygons keyed by PARCELID: https://gis-public.sandiegocounty.gov/arcgis/rest/services/DPW/LEAMS_Reference/MapServer/16?f=pjson (safe extracted evidence in evidence/source-inspection.json).

First-party metadata identifies the San Diego County Parcel Base; the unchanged Encinitas locator falls within the official layer extent. The frozen packet and service review record a bounded locator probe and independent reads of native IDs 5122131 and 5122172. Fresh bounded official reads confirm both IDs; this establishes local scope only.
